widgetData.source_sentence: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: In Aksharamanamalai, which verse contains the prayer asking Arunachala to rule over the devotee graciously through his Holy Feet?
sentences: [Aksharamanamalai] Verse 4: Arunachala! For whose sake dids’t Thou claim me? Thou, who ruled over me happily earlier were to abandon me thereafter with disdain the whole world will heap calumny on Thee.
[Aksharamanamalai] Verse 63: Holy Feet and be pleased to rule over me graciously.
[Aksharamanamalai] Verse 105: May Thou live for all eternity protecting forever the poor and hapless devotees like me all over, bestowing on all the infinite and rapturous bliss in Siva.

[The Legend of King Ballala] In this holy place was the seat of the kingdom of King Ballala... Arunachala came in the form of a Child and played in this King’s lap... the Lord said that as the King had no progeny He would Himself perform his annual ceremonies (sraddha) for all eternity | Topics: arunachala_kshetra

[Verse 799] One who walks firmly on the path / That leads to immortality may / Swerve through neglect or other cause / From the strict Vedic way; but never / May he transgress his Master’s word | Topics: guru_vachaka_kovai

[] If you seek either [God or Self]... they are not really two but one and identical... rest assured that they are seeking you with a solicitude greater than you can ever imagine | Topics: citation_sentences

sentences: [Self-Knowledge (Atma-Vidya)] Verse 3: Of what avail is knowing things other than the Self? And the Self being known, what other thing is there to know? [] The master is formless Self. That is within you | Topics: citation_sentences
[] You mistake the body for the Guru... He is the formless Self. That is within you | Topics: citation_sentences

sentences: [The Penance of Gauri (Parvati)] Sati Devi... was subsequently born to Himavantha and Menaka.... she at last came here to Arunachala where she got the approbation of Arunagireeswara, and obtained Ardhanareeswara (half the body of Siva) | Topics: arunachala_kshetra

[Realization of the Self] Even if the body died, the sense of ‘I’ did not go. The consciousness of individuality was very much there... ‘I’ did not perish because ‘I’ was not the body | Topics: events
